properties.notes: Demolition of existing warehouse and redevelopment including construction of a two storey building with first floor rear roof terrace situated at front of site and single storey building with accommodation in the roof at rear of site with associated car parking,cycle parking, refuse/recycling storage and associated landscaping to provide six residential units (1 x 1 bedroom, 3 x 2 bedroom and 2 x 3 bedroom units).
